## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by a test (merge case, snapshot, or unit test)
- [ ] Format details I relied on are verified against Godot's source or real files and noted in `DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (user-visible changes)
